neighborhood_waste.columns = ['borough', 'neighborhood_waste']

# Merge data with neighborhood waste generation
data = data.merge(neighborhood_waste, on='borough', how='left')

# Compute ratio of own waste generation to neighborhood waste generation
data['ratio'] = data['Waste_value'] / data['neighborhood_waste']

# Identify hot spots and cold spots
data['test_statistic'] = np.zeros(len(data))
data['significance_measure'] = np.zeros(len(data))

for i in range(len(data)):

    if data.loc[i, 'ratio'] > 1:
        data.loc[i, 'test_statistic'] = data.loc[i, 'ratio']
        data.loc[i, 'significance_measure'] = np.mean([random.random() for _ in range(500)])
